meta.title: AG Grid vs Syncfusion: Features, Pricing and Licensing
meta.description: Compare AG Grid and Syncfusion Data Grid feature by feature: framework support, free and paid features, large datasets, pricing and licensing.

hero.heading: AG Grid vs Syncfusion
hero.subHeading: Compare AG Grid vs Syncfusion Data Grid on framework support, free and paid features, large datasets, pricing and licensing.

shortAnswer: AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence for organisations of any size. Syncfusion Data Grid is commercial software: its free Community License is limited to organisations with under $1M annual gross revenue, 5 or fewer developers and 10 or fewer employees, and other organisations need a paid licence such as the Grid SDK, an annual subscription per developer. Both support React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript, and Syncfusion also covers Blazor, other .NET platforms and Flutter. In Syncfusion, pivoting and tree data are separate Pivot Table and Tree Grid components; in AG Grid they are features of the grid itself, in [AG Grid Enterprise](/license-pricing/).

faq.question: How much does Syncfusion cost?
faq.answer: The Syncfusion Grid SDK and the UI Component Suite, which includes all seven of Syncfusion's standalone UI SDKs, are both annual subscriptions per developer, with a minimum term of one year, and include Business Support. Syncfusion publishes its prices on its pricing page. Organisations that meet the Community License limits can apply for a free licence.

faq.question: Is Syncfusion UI free?
faq.answer: Only for organisations that qualify for the Syncfusion Community License: under $1M annual gross revenue, 5 or fewer developers, 10 or fewer employees and never more than $3M in outside capital. Government bodies funded by taxes are not eligible. AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence for any organisation.

faq.question: What is Syncfusion used for?
faq.answer: Syncfusion sells UI component libraries for web, desktop and mobile applications, including a data grid, charts, a scheduler and document-processing SDKs.

faq.question: Does Syncfusion work with Angular?
faq.answer: Yes. Syncfusion Data Grid is available for Angular, React, Vue and JavaScript. AG Grid also supports all four.

faq.question: What is AG Grid used for?
faq.answer: AG Grid is a JavaScript data grid for displaying, editing and analysing tabular data in web applications built with React, Angular, Vue or plain JavaScript. Its features include sorting, filtering, cell editing and virtualisation for large datasets and, in Enterprise, row grouping, pivoting, Excel export and integrated charts.

faq.question: Can I use AG Grid for free?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Community is free and open source under the MIT licence, including for commercial use. AG Grid Enterprise is a paid licence that adds features such as row grouping, pivoting, Excel export and the Server-Side Row Model. See [Community vs Enterprise](./community-vs-enterprise/).

faq.question: Does AG Grid have AI features for users?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Enterprise's AI Toolkit connects your own LLM so users can query and change the grid in plain language. Syncfusion's web Data Grid has no built-in AI features; its Smart DataGrid is for .NET MAUI and WPF only.

proseClaims.claim: Syncfusion Data Grid is commercial software.

Syncfusion's free Community License is limited to organisations with under $1M annual gross revenue, 5 or fewer developers and 10 or fewer employees that have never received more than $3M in outside capital; government bodies funded by taxes are not eligible; eligible organisations apply and are validated.
Organisations outside the Community License limits need a paid licence.
Syncfusion Data Grid supports React, Angular, Vue and JavaScript, and also Blazor, other .NET platforms and Flutter.
In Syncfusion, pivoting and tree data are separate Pivot Table and Tree Grid components, included in the Grid SDK.
Syncfusion sells UI component libraries for web, desktop and mobile applications, including a data grid, charts, a scheduler and document-processing SDKs.
Syncfusion has an MCP server for AI coding assistants, which needs a Syncfusion licence and an API key.
The Syncfusion Smart DataGrid is for .NET MAUI and WPF only, and the Grid SDK includes the Data Grid, Tree Grid, Pivot Table and Smart DataGrid.
Syncfusion Data Grid supports lazy-load grouping for large datasets.
The Syncfusion Grid SDK and UI Component Suite are annual subscriptions per developer, minimum one year, including Business Support; the UI Component Suite includes all seven standalone UI SDKs.
